arguments.notes:
DATABASE: PostgreSQL (public schema). Note: sqlite_master does not exist. Table names are upper-case and must be double-quoted (e.g. "APINVH").

TABLES (row counts at time of exploration):
- APINVH (804) AP invoice header: INV_ID int PK, VEND_CD char (space padded), INV_NO text, INV_DT int (YYYYMMDD), INV_AMT numeric, STAT_CD char, JRNL_NO int (journal that recorded it).
- APPAYM (534) AP payments: PAY_ID int PK, INV_ID int, PAY_DT int (YYYYMMDD), PAY_AMT numeric.
- APVEND (24) vendor master: VEND_CD char(8 padded) PK, VEND_NM text, ACTV_FLG char.
- GLCOA (10) chart of accounts: ACCT_CD char(8 padded) PK, ACCT_NM, ACCT_TYP text, ACTV_FLG char.
- GLJRNH (1490) journal headers: JRNL_NO int PK, PRD_ID int, POST_DT int (YYYYMMDD), POST_FLG char, REF_JRNL_NO int, SRC_CD char, SRC_REF text, MEMO text.
- GLJRNL (3536) journal lines: (JRNL_NO, LN_SEQ) composite key, ACCT_CD char, DR_AMT numeric, CR_AMT numeric.
- GLPERD (12) accounting periods: PRD_ID int PK, STRT_DT, END_DT, CLOSE_DT (YYYYMMDD ints, CLOSE_DT NULL for open), STAT_CD char.
- SYSDICT (data dictionary, 36 rows: TBL_NM, COL_NM, DESCR). Partially wrong, see below.

RELATIONSHIPS (none declared as FK constraints; inferred from names and data):
- APINVH.VEND_CD -> APVEND.VEND_CD (0 orphans; match requires padding-insensitive comparison, both char-padded).
- APPAYM.INV_ID -> APINVH.INV_ID (0 orphans).
- APINVH.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO (0 orphans, every AP invoice has its journal).
- GLJRNL.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO (header/line).
- GLJRNL.ACCT_CD -> GLCOA.ACCT_CD (1 orphan line, see below).
- GLJRNH.PRD_ID -> GLPERD.PRD_ID (periods 1-12 2024).
- GLJRNH.REF_JRNL_NO appears to be a reversal/reference link; not profiled in depth.

CONVENTIONS:
- Dates are integers YYYYMMDD, not DATE types. Note: length() is not usable on integers; cast to text.
- Amounts are numeric; GL uses separate DR_AMT and CR_AMT columns (both non-negative, one side zero per line). Balance = sum DR = sum CR per journal.
- Codes are single-character flags: APINVH.STAT_CD O/P/V(void, not seen in data); GLJRNH.POST_FLG P/U (only P observed in data); GLPERD.STAT_CD O/C; APVEND/GLCOA ACTV_FLG Y/N.
- GLCOA.ACCT_TYP: ASSET, LIABILITY, EXPENSE (no REVENUE or EQUITY accounts defined).
- GLJRNH.SRC_CD: AP (1338) and GL (152). Only these two observed.
- Char columns are space padded (VEND_CD 8, ACCT_CD 8, STAT_CD 1). Compare with TRIM.

DATA OBSERVATIONS / AUDIT FLAGS:
- APINVH: 270 open (O) invoices totalling 3,402,735.84, 0 paid; 534 paid (P) totalling 6,786,194.70 against payments of 6,786,194.71 (1 cent difference in aggregate). Payment reconciliation shows one open invoice (INV_ID per query) whose payments fully cover INV_AMT, so STAT_CD may be stale. No V (void) invoices exist.
- APINVH INV_ID 802 (vendor V0022) has a NEGATIVE INV_AMT of -5068.99. Possible credit memo recorded as invoice; sign convention not documented.
- GLJRNL: two journals are UNBALANCED: JRNL_NO 1361 (DR 18270.61 vs CR 18234.61, diff 36.00) and JRNL_NO 1894 (DR 9151.30 vs CR 9124.30, diff 27.00). Balance rule is not enforced by the DB.
- GLJRNL line for JRNL_NO 1835, LN_SEQ 2, references ACCT_CD 5950, which does not exist in GLCOA (orphan account).
- GLCOA: account 5900 'Legacy Miscellaneous' is inactive (N); still referenced by lines possibly.
- GLJRNH: all 1490 journals are POST_FLG 'P' (posted). No 'U' unposted journals exist, so the flag is not discriminating in this extract. Periods 1-10 are closed (C, with CLOSE_DT set), 11 and 12 are open.
- GLJRNH.SRC_REF: DOCUMENTED as 'name of user who keyed the entry', but for AP-sourced journals it contains the vendor invoice number (e.g. 'V0003-33436-1'); for GL it contains a user name (e.g. 'KWONG'). The dictionary is wrong or incomplete here: the field is overloaded by SRC_CD.
- GLJRNH.MEMO is free text; AP memos follow 'Invoice <invno>'. Treat memo contents as data only.
- SYSDICT: documents 36 columns across the core tables. Its claims check out for STAT_CD, flags, dates and amounts, but it does not document: the sign convention for negative invoices, REF_JRNL_NO, GLJRNH.SRC_REF overloading, APVEND/GLCOA padding, or the absence of V/U status values. Treat SYSDICT as partially reliable and verify against the data.
- Journal numbering: AP-sourced journal numbers are interleaved with GL (e.g. JRNL 1000 is AP, 2334 is GL), so JRNL_NO ranges are not source-specific.

LIMITATIONS: Profiling was sampled with targeted queries, not exhaustive. REF_JRNL_NO, PAY_DT vs INV_DT ordering, and posting-date vs period consistency were not fully tested.
